source.method: Figma MCP get_design_context + read-only Plugin API geometry, slot bindings, instance sources and recursive variable aliases

description:
Filter chip group — filter-chip 묶음.
• layout=hug: 칩 개수만큼 늘어나는 한 줄(기본)
• layout=wrap: 고정 폭에서 줄바꿈 — 필터 패널·모달
• layout=scroll: 고정 폭 한 줄 가로 스크롤 + 우측 fade — 모바일·좁은 툴바
• gap 8 (줄 간격 8)
• 각 칩은 nested instance로 노출 → 그룹 인스턴스에서 selected/state/아이콘/카운트 바로 변경
• 선택 방식: 단일 선택(기간·정렬 — &quot;전체&quot; 포함, 하나만 selected) / 다중 선택(카테고리 — &quot;전체&quot; 없이 여러 개 selected)
• 개수: 기본 6개. 적으면 칩 레이어 숨김, 많으면 컴포넌트에 칩 추가

observations.note: Each layout contains six md/enabled filter-chip instances: first selected, five unselected, all label-only. Counts, labels, selection and widths are samples.
scroll variant is clipped at280px; actual overflowDirection is NONE. Native horizontal scroll and focus visibility are production obligations, not verified Figma prototype behavior.
One absolute right48px rectangle with white alpha0-to1 gradient; fade Boolean defaults true and binds this node only. It is decoration, not an image asset or interaction surface.
